payload.title: Sony also closed Bluepoint Games before Dark Outlaw; PlayStation studio closures accelerate in 2026
payload.content: Sony closed Bluepoint Games, the studio known for remastering Demon's Souls and Shadow of the Colossus, shortly before also closing Jason Blundell's Dark Outlaw Games in March 2026. The back-to-back first-party closures signal an acceleration of PlayStation's studio consolidation strategy, with around 50 staff losing jobs across the mobile and first-party teams.
